points.text: Elon Musk says he plans to give two SpaceX shares to every child in the United States, with headlines estimating a total value of about $18 billion.
FIFA says hackers accessed a limited set of personal and business information, while Flight Centre is investigating a cyber incident that may have exposed customer records.
A federal judge temporarily barred the FCC from pursuing early license reviews for ABC broadcast stations.
A FedEx cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport, temporarily leaving all but one runway closed and causing delays.
Donald Trump and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte urged Russia not to widen the Ukraine war; Trump also said he asked Vladimir Putin to pull back military aggression in Europe.
